user.title: hasspy
user.description: Add the hasspy bridge. This is a local sink that a hasspy runtime publishes entities into; no settings are required.

register_bridge.name: Register bridge
register_bridge.description: Announce a hasspy process. Idempotent; safe to call on every (re)connect.

name.name: Name
name.description: Human-readable name shown on the device.

scope.name: Scope
scope.description: Default scope for entities created without one.

run_id.name: Run id
run_id.description: Opaque id that changes on every process start.

stale_after.name: Stale after
stale_after.description: Seconds without a heartbeat before the bridge counts as offline.

heartbeat.name: Heartbeat
heartbeat.description: Keep a bridge alive and refresh its automation list.

remove_bridge.name: Remove bridge
remove_bridge.description: Forget a bridge, optionally deleting all of its entities.

create_entity.name: Create entity
create_entity.description: Create or update a dynamic entity. Returns its entity_id.

automation.name: Automation
automation.description: Owning app instance id, for grouping and lifecycle.

key.name: Key
key.description: Stable key, unique within the automation.

scope.name: Scope
scope.description: production is permanent; debug is lease-managed.

ttl.name: Lease TTL
ttl.description: Debug only: seconds before the entity goes stale.

pin.name: Pin
pin.description: Debug only: exempt from garbage collection.

set_entity_state.name: Set entity state
set_entity_state.description: Push a state (and/or attributes) to a dynamic entity, refreshing its lease.

purge.name: Purge
purge.description: Also remove it from the registry.

list_bridges.name: List bridges
list_bridges.description: Return every registered bridge with its online state.

release_session.name: Release debug session
release_session.description: Delete every debug entity of a bridge (or one automation) immediately. The graceful-shutdown path.

sweep.name: Sweep
sweep.description: Run garbage collection now. dry_run returns the verdicts without deleting.

pin.name: Pin debug entities
pin.description: Exempt a bridge's (or automation's) debug entities from collection.
